pass_a_gloss: Theater of world/angels; Hades taunts the denier; Elijah's two-hams choice.
pass_b_english: But since our contest is a spectacle to the world — 'for we are made a theater to the world and angels and men' (1 Corinthians 4:9) — let us consider who beholds: God the president, angels clapping as rivers clap with hands, saints rejoicing. Hades too below stirs, saying to the denier: 'Hades below was embittered meeting thee; all the giants rose to thee.' (Psalm 98:8) Choose then before whom to contend nobly: before God and angels unto glory, or before Hades unto shame. 'He who loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me.' (Isaiah 14:9–20) And Elijah's word stands: 'How long halt ye on both hams? If the Lord be God, go after him; but if Baal, go after him.' (Matthew 10:37) (1 Kings 18:21)
